title: Severe allergic reaction
plain: Swelling of the lips, tongue or throat or trouble breathing after a food, medicine or contact. Epinephrine first: every minute counts.

steps.detail: Do this before anything else. An expired injector is still better than none.

steps.text: Call the crew medical officer. Say: severe allergy.
Lie down with the legs raised. If breathing is hard, sit up instead. Do not stand or walk.

steps.question: Is breathing easier and has the swelling stopped growing?

steps.text: Then give an antihistamine for the itch and hives
Stay with a crewmate for at least 4 hours: symptoms can come back. Keep a second injector close.

escalation: Still struggling to breathe after 2 epinephrine doses: oxygen and the anaphylaxis checklist with the CMO (EMG-SEVERE-ALLERGY). Earth is informed.
